Class Vector3

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Vector3
public class Vector3 extends Object
Represents a direction/displacement vector in 3D space with x, y, z components.

Design goal: zero garbage in hot paths (ray tracing inner loops). Every method that can mutate this and return this does so. The only two methods that are documented as ALLOCATES are times(double) and clone(): their signatures have no pre-allocated target parameter to write into, so allocation cannot be avoided without changing their signature. Prefer multiply(double) over times(double) in any hot path.

    • refract

      public boolean refract(Vector3 normal, double eta)
      Refracts this vector through a surface with the given relative index of refraction eta = n1/n2 (mutates this in place). No allocation.

      Current sign convention is preserved exactly as-is (verified working / visually correct in this engine); do not change without re-validating every call site and the resulting render output.

      Returns:
      true if refraction succeeded, false on total internal reflection

    • refract

      public boolean refract(Vector3 normal, double n1, double n2)

    • refract

      public boolean refract(Vector3 normal, double eta, Vector3 target)
      Refracts this vector with a single eta ratio and stores in target. target = refracted direction, or unchanged if total internal reflection. No allocation.
      Parameters:
      normal - The surface normal (normalized)
      eta - The ratio of indices of refraction (n1/n2)
      target - The vector to store the result
      Returns:
      true if refraction succeeded, false if total internal reflection
